verdict.rationale: Column's evidence shows only programmatic HTTP APIs, a Dashboard, an OpenAPI spec and an llms.txt file. None of these is a first-party natural-language command interface. The llms.txt and OpenAPI spec are developer building blocks that an external agent could use, not a product capability for operating Column through natural language, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
